title: Tail-Adaptive Honest Intervals for Lower-Tail Complier Effects with Instruments
banked_reason: The promised matched union-honest frontier, optimal simultaneous factor, and a single attaining interval are still explicitly open, so the current closed kernel supplies only oracle/fixed-level/loose-bracket constraints rather than the focal usable Stat deliverable.

The delivered quantitative characterization is the matched known-exponent oracle benchmark; the focal unknown-exponent union-honest profiles, oracle penalty across joint sequences, and optimal simultaneous adaptation factor remain unresolved.

proof_attempt_summary: Two D0 solve rounds and a scoped maximality repair produced sound oracle and fixed-level results, finite-bin comparisons, and loose full-union brackets. Six classical citations were independently recovered and attested, and the math referee passed, but the original matched union-honest frontier, optimal simultaneous factor, and attaining interval remain open. Independent validity review confirmed terminal kernel substitution; no F-stage or Lean proof was launched, and retry requires a new faithful construction rather than plain resume.
tldr: Lower-tail averages describe program effects for vulnerable compliers, while observed instrument cells mix their earnings with noncomplier earnings. For the local density-envelope IV class, we prove an explicit finite-sample expected-length bound when the exponents are supplied and, for each fixed public \((\epsilon,p)\), a globally honest exponent-blind interval whose expected length has the same \(n^{-1/2}\) order, with constants allowed to depend on \((\epsilon,p)\). We also prove finite-bin/full-record testing inequalities and explicit loose full-union brackets. Determining matched classwise union-honest profiles over all joint sequences, the associated phase transitions, and one interval attaining the optimal simultaneous factor remains Open Questions \(\texttt{oeq:testing-calibration}\) and \(\texttt{oeq:honest-frontier}\). The model excludes zero atoms below a public onset and permits arbitrary body laws, including atoms.
gap: Fixed-level complier shortfall inference and extreme-IV extrapolation leave finite-sample honest precision over the local first-order density-envelope union unevaluated. General adaptation theory supplies testing architecture but does not evaluate this marked-mixture experiment and nonlinear raw target.
fill: The deliverable is evaluable matched oracle and union-honest length profiles, their ratio, the optimal simultaneous factor \(A\), and one exponent-blind interval with coverage at least \(0.90\) at every finite tuple. Explicit marked-bin power brackets, lawful full-record lifts and quantified expected-width error connect certified computation to complete-mixture converses.
